description: This file defines the 'CollectionDemoActivity' class, an Android activity that demonstrates collection navigation using ViewPager and fragments. It includes inner classes for a pager adapter to manage fragments and a fragment class to display individual collection items.

classes.name: CollectionDemoActivity
classes.description: The main activity demonstrating collection navigation with ViewPager and fragments.

classes.name: DemoCollectionPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to supply fragments for each page in the collection.

classes.name: DemoObjectFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing an individual item in the collection, displaying a number.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager and action bar.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles the action bar item clicks, specifically the Up/Home button.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns a fragment for the specified position; creates a DemoObjectFragment with a specific argument.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the collection (100).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for each page.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view for the fragment, displaying the number.
